# `probe/PROBE.json`

Generated by `make_tool_fixtures.py` through `models_probe.probe_run` with a
fake `client_factory`: each experimental model returns a fixed `OK` reply with
a normalised usage dict (3 reasoning tokens).  `deepseek-flash` reports a seed,
so its `seed_deterministic` is `true`; the others are `null`.  No network call
was made.  Only `created_at` is wall-clock; everything else is fixed.
